Sensitivity can be set to extremely high 
to ensure consistent detection even when 
the temperature difference between the 
human body and the environment is 
very small.
Super high sensitivity
IR Anti-masking  
Dual anti-masking feature that protects individually 
both PIR and microwave sensors generating an 
alert if they are covered.
Double conductive shielding  
OPTEX patented double conductive shielding 
allows FlipX Advanced sensors to block RFI and 
the visible light disturbance from sunlight or strong 
lamps, to focus on what matters.
Flexible mounting height and selectable look-down area
A selectable ‘Down zone’ switch allows to create a look down 
zone below the sensor. And its flexible mounting height between 
2 - 3 m means they seamlessly blend into the aesthetics of 
buildings with higher ceilings.
